title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: usage-based billing models in the model selector
summary: Hold for corrections to the configuration guidance. The summary describes spending limits as mandatory although Microsoft permits unlimited monthly spending, and two navigation paths omit or change documented labels. The rollout, subscription requirement and usage-based charging are supported.

claims.claim: Administrators must set spending limits to enable the models.

claims.fix: Replace the summary's second sentence with: 'Admins must enable usage-based billing and provide credits; they can configure spending limits, and in-product credit requests are planned for later.' The documented setup permits unlimited monthly spending and makes per-user limits optional.

claims.where: What's changing; front matter: licensing.notes; Governance controls
claims.claim: Spending policies define access and limits rather than reserve or allocate credits.
claims.quote: Spending policies only define access and spending limits, not credit allocation. / Spending policies are limit-based controls and don't reserve or allocate Copilot Credits to users or groups.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Identity-based spending policies govern users or groups.
claims.quote: Create and name the policy and then choose Identity as the scope. Use this option when you need to manage usage by users or groups for a supported service.

claims.claim: A user moving between Entra ID groups takes on the new group's spending policy.
claims.quote: If a user moves from one Microsoft Entra ID group to another during a billing period, the new group's spending policy becomes effective for the user.

claims.claim: Consumption history carries forward across a group-policy change.
claims.quote: However, the user's consumption history carries forward across the policy change.

claims.claim: A spending policy can impose a monthly credit limit.
claims.quote: Limited monthly budget: When you select a limited monthly budget, you limit the number of credits that this policy can spend each month.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: pilot limits
claims.claim: A spending policy can impose per-user monthly credit limits.
claims.quote: Select monthly budget limits for users (optional). Use the toggle to select this option and to set a monthly limit for users to prevent a single person from spending all available credits.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: alerts
claims.claim: Spending-policy alerts notify recipients at configured thresholds.
claims.quote: Select the administrators or stakeholders who must receive email notifications when policy usage reaches the threshold.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: access after hitting a limit
claims.claim: Users hitting the limit lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month.
claims.quote: When users hit the limit, they lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month until credits reset on the first of the month.
claims.fix: Keep the cited rule but append: 'The monitoring documentation separately says a running task can complete without interruption after exceeding a per-user limit in a group spending policy.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-copilot-credits-monitor-spending#consumption-tab, which states: 'If a running task exceeds the per-user limit, it can complete without interruption.'
